name: Scorpion & Sub-Zero
creator: kaizen
description:
**Features:**
- Two versions to choose from - fight as either Scorpion or Sub-Zero!

- Custom model and textures

- Support for all quality settings

- Custom loading screen

- Custom VO

- Custom VFX

- The full support of Lin Kuei and Shirai Ryu


Another 3 year old skin remastered! New textures and VFX for both Ninjas, and now Scorpion is no longer locked behind a skin. Simply pick the version with the ninja you prefer and you are good to go!
Do bear in mind, however, that I haven't touched anything model and weights-wise, so you'll still see some stretching or holes in the mesh. Not really visible during gameplay tho. Enjoy!
